'''Peden''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed at the [[Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], he led [[Grek team]] on a priority assault mission against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces, which ended in failure after the entire [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]], including Peden, was massacred by Republic [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Back at the garrison [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[G0-S5]] alerted an Imperial to Peden's disappearance, urging them to complete the mission.
